sources.title: Subhas Chandra Bose · An Indian Pilgrim, chapters I and V
sources.note: Printed pages 6–7 describe his birth, father and childhood city; page 39 places his arrival at Ravenshaw Collegiate School in January 1909; pages 43–46 recall Beni Madhav Das, their correspondence and attention to nature. This is Bose’s retrospective account of his youth.
